messages:
jess_lead: FYI — planning a maintenance/change window for runtime pinning to avoid a perf regression. Target: tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Need statuspage blurb + email template we can send to affected customers.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: runtime-pin v3.2.1 -> canary (10%). ETA start 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z. Will report back on canary metrics.

priya_oncall: +1. I'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards during the window. If 95th latency up > 20% or error-rate spike > 3% we hold and consider rollback.

sam_support: Can we provide a short customer-facing line that doesn't leak internal thresholds? e.g., "We will perform a brief maintenance to apply compatibility pinning to our inference runtime. You may see brief request latency increases; we will monitor and mitigate." Thoughts?

karen_custsuccess: That sounds good. Add an expected window (30m) and a note about how to reach us. Customers like an explicit fallback promise: "We will roll back if we see user-impacting errors."

nora_writer: Draft statuspage snippet and email. Drop feedback here and I'll iterate.

nora_writer: STATUSPAGE DRAFT:
```
Maintenance: brief runtime update to improve model compatibility
Start: 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC
Duration: ~30 minutes (may be shorter)
Impact: Possible short service latency increase for some requests. No expected data loss.
Notes: If we detect degraded customer experience we will roll back and post updates here.
```

nora_writer: EMAIL SNIPPET:
```
Subject: Upcoming maintenance — brief runtime update (Mar 25, 03:00 UTC)

Hi <Customer>,

We will apply a small runtime compatibility update on 25 Mar at 03:00 UTC. The change is expected to take up to 30 minutes. During that time a subset of requests may see slightly higher latency.

We will monitor in real time and will roll back immediately if we detect any user-impacting issues. No action is required on your side.

If you have concerns or a hard latency SLA, please reply to this message and we will coordinate.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops
```

dennis_sre: +1 to the wording. Add a line in the email about the service status page link.

nora_writer: updated email snippet with statuspage link note.

deploy-bot: Canary report: 10% traffic now. 5m window. Current metrics: 95th latency +8%, error-rate delta +0.6%. No automated hold.

priya_oncall: Watching. Metrics look within acceptable band so far. Keep canary running to 15m and then promote if stable.

deploy-bot: Canary update: at 12m 95th latency drifted to +22% and error-rate rose to +3.8%. Triggering canary-hold.

deploy-bot: Canary-hold active. Not promoting. Recommend rollback to v3.1.8 for canary and schedule a full rollback if rollout had proceeded.

jess_lead: Thanks. This is why we pinned the version. We should push an immediate statuspage update and send the pre-approved email to high-SLA customers. Priya — please execute rollback for canary now.

priya_oncall: Executing rollback: rollback-command: `deploy rollback runtime v3.2.1 --target canary --to v3.1.8`

deploy-bot: Rollback started. Canary reverted to v3.1.8. Confirming metrics backfill.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics after rollback (3m): 95th latency back to +3% vs baseline, error-rate +0.4%. Canary stable.

statusbot: POSTING STATUSPAGE UPDATE:
"Maintenance update: We paused the runtime pin rollout after observing increased latency during canary. We rolled back the canary to the previous runtime version; service metrics have returned to normal. We will not proceed with the broader rollout until we complete a follow-up investigation."

sam_support: I'll send the high-SLA email now to the shortlist and post the statuspage update. Using the email snippet with the rollback note.

karen_custsuccess: I'll notify our top 10 customers proactively and offer a 1:1 sync if they want details.

jess_lead: Follow-up actions:
- dennis_sre: capture canary traces + perf profile and open an investigation ticket.
- eng-releases: pause any scheduled automated promotions for this runtime.
- nora_writer: update the public status message with timeframe for investigation (ETA 4 hours).

dennis_sre: Ticket opened: INF-4129 with perf artifacts attached.

nora_writer: Updated statuspage copy to add investigation ETA 4 hours and link to INF-4129.

jess_lead: Great. Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the investigation. :thumbsup:

priya_oncall: marking as resolved on-call for now. Will escalate if anything new shows up.
